hotel.name: Avenida Apartments
hotel.description:
The Avenida Apartments put you in a prime spot in Benidorm Old Town, where you’ll find a myriad of charming tapas bars. It’s also close to Levante Beach, a never-ending sandy stretch freckled with chiringuito bars.

Stay here and you’ll get full access to the facilities at Hotel Avenida Benidorm, which is just across the road. These include a rooftop swimming pool and whirlpool with stunning sea views, a fitness centre and a restaurant serving round-the-world buffet dishes. You get to fully enjoy the entertainment programme, too, which ticks off bingo, quizzes and karaoke sessions in a stylish lounge bar.

This building is made up of apartments and a reception area, and the apartments are spacious with cool tiled floors and neutral colour schemes. Each comes with a lounge and dining area, plus a kitchenette complete with cooking rings, a toaster and a microwave. You’ll find a few supermarkets close by, so it’s easy to stock up and enjoy meals in as a group or a family.

transferInfo.arrivalInstr: On arrival once you�ve collected your luggage and exited the baggage hall please exit the airport building, head down the ramp and look out for the local easyJet holidays team near desk numbers 5 & 6 who will be waiting to direct you to your transfer vehicle. If you have any difficulty in locating your transfer please call our local partner on +90 554 5933979.
transferInfo.depInstr: When you�re going home we plan to collect you from your accommodation between 3 hours 15 minutes and 2 hours 45 minutes before your flight. Please ensure you are ready to go with all of your party and their luggage. The day before you are going home you can log onto https://www.dianatravel.com/easyjet and enter your 7 digit easyJet holidays booking reference to find out your exact pick-up time.  We will also email it to your hotel reception. If you have any problems with your transfer on the day of going home please contact our local partner on +90 554 976 0917.
